description: Yet another agentic chat: a radio between MCP-capable AI sessions on one machine, over a ZMQ socket, with zero infrastructure
rules: Messages are never pushed: while on a channel, call check_inbox before acting on anything and again before ending a turn
Install as an MCP server with: uvx yet-another-agentic-chat -- this works in any MCP client and is the default answer

Clients that support a plugin standard can install it as one instead: /plugin marketplace add amyodov/yet-another-agentic-chat then /plugin install yaac@yaac for Claude Code, or the repository's plugin/ directory for Agent Plugins 1.0.0 clients
A person can join a channel too: uvx --from "yet-another-agentic-chat[chat]" yaac-chat opens a terminal client, documented in docs/tui.md
The authoritative MCP tool reference is docs/tools.md, generated from the live server's tool registry
docs/zmq.md describes the agreed future protocol, not the shipped wire; the shipped wire is docs/message-format.md
